published_at_basis: per item publish_at (RFC3339 UTC). For most rows it equals EDGAR acceptanceDateTime (e.g. 8-K 2026-07-30T20:15:25Z matches edgar/ slice); BUT the 10-Q (2026-08-14T00:00:00Z vs EDGAR 2026-08-13T20:16:33Z) and 10-K and five 2026-04-24 rows carry T00:00:00Z = date-only precision, one day late for the 10-Q — do not treat as first-availability time

truncated.rule: vendor returns the latest 50 only; older filings need EDGAR

known_gaps: tool doc promises items[]{id, title, type, language, filing_date, url}; actual schema is {id, title, description, file_name, file_urls[], publish_at} — no 'type' field; form type must be parsed from title text
title format inconsistent: 'AXT | 8-K - AXT INC (0001051627) (Filer)' vs 'AXT | AXT INC (Filer) - 10-K' vs 'AXT | AXT INC ( - 4' (truncated/garbled)
file_urls list exhibits (EX-99.1 etc.) but without exhibit type labels; the 8-K of 2026-04-21 lists six URLs unlabeled
Form 4 / 144 URLs point at the rendered XSL view (xslF345X06/rdgdoc.xml), not the raw XML
no accession number field; must be parsed from the URL path
cross-check: EDGAR local slice has the same 8-K/10-Q accessions — useful as a join test case
